doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Eric Dixon
summary: Young recalls tenor saxophonist Eric Dixon as a wonderful man he used to kid.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Let‘s talk about some of other guys in that Count Basie band. We talked about Sonny Payne already. What about Eric Dixon the other tenor saxophone player.

Eric Dixon was very good, very nice man. Wonderful man, I used to kid him a lot. I forgot what, we had a kidding thing going on between, but I can‘t remember what it was, I wish I could tell you because it was a funny thing. We used to [laughs] some kind of name I wish I could think of, but Eric Dixon, he was a nice man, man. Good cat. Beautiful man.
